premises: Hybrid cryo-rolling + warm-rolling at 600°C produces a dual heterogeneous microstructure in AlCoCrFeNi2.1
The dual microstructure consists of retained lamellar and transformed nanocrystalline regions
Cryo-rolling stores energy that accelerates phase transformation during subsequent warm-rolling
The dual heterogeneous microstructure yields an unprecedented combination of strength (~2000 MPa) and ductility (~8%)
The dual microstructure can improve room-temperature creep and corrosion resistance under temperature fluctuations
